nom: Dickinson's Witch Hazel Pore Perfecting Toner

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, reporting no irritation and, in some cases, help clearing hormonal breakouts, but one reviewer describes a severe reaction — large bumps, spreading redness, and a dry, harsh feeling — that she calls a nightmare for her sensitive skin.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some who are also acne-prone, report the toner removes excess oil and controls shine without over-drying, though one says she hasn't noticed a significant reduction in pimples despite the clean feeling.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with oily skin, report the toner does not dry out or strip their skin despite containing alcohol; one reviewer with sensitive skin is the exception, describing it as feeling very dry and harsh on her face.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the toner helps calm redness or reduce the look of enlarged, red pores over time, while one reviewer with sensitive skin reports the opposite — spreading redness alongside large bumps after use.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including many with sensitive skin, report no irritation and describe the toner as gentle; one reviewer's sensitive skin reacted with large bumps, redness, and a harsh, dry feeling that worsened with continued use.
concerns.spots: A small number of reviewers mention dark spots, saying the toner helps tone or fade them, but this feedback is limited and not detailed.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone or oily, report fewer or faster-healing breakouts, with some describing dramatic clearing within days; one reviewer with oily skin reports no significant reduction in pimples despite otherwise liking the product, and one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced new large bumps and pimples.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report the toner removes excess oil and controls shine through the day without over-drying, with several using it specifically on days their skin feels extra oily.

extraits.texte: I purchased this instead of my typical micellar water because of the high ratings. I do not have issues with breakouts or acne but do get some dry patches here and there. This product immediately started causing me to have very big bumps/pimples on my face. I was hopeful if I continued use after the initial introduction it would clear up, but unfortunately you can see the severity of these bumps and redness in the photos. Each day more would pop up. It does not smell pleasant and it feels very dry and harsh on my skin. Everyone has different skin types, but for my sensitive skin, this is an absolute nightmare. There seems to be many skin reactions from the product, so be warned!

I have oily skin and this toner has become a staple in my routine. I primarily use it as a second-step cleanser after washing my face, and occasionally as a quick mask by applying it with cotton pads for a few minutes. It effectively removes any leftover impurities and excess oil without over-drying. The 16oz bottle is huge and very affordable—excellent value for money. I appreciate that it contains 100% natural witch hazel, but please note it also includes 14% Natural Grain Alcohol. You can definitely smell the alcohol when applying, but it doesn’t feel harsh on my skin. After use, my face feels fresh, clean, and never sticky or tight. It truly helps refine pores and control shine throughout the day. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a straightforward, effective, and budget-friendly toner!

extraits.auteur: Luffy’s Mom I Real Life Tester
extraits.titre: Gentle, effective for oily skin, very affordable
extraits.texte: I’ve been using the Deaconson Original Witch Hazel Toner for 2–3 years and really like it. All the ingredients are Yuka App approved, safe and clean, and the bottle is large and economical. I usually use it only when my face gets oily or I have a lot of breakouts. This toner is great for cleansing oily skin—it leaves my face feeling very clean without being harsh. I haven’t noticed a significant reduction in pimples, but I enjoy using it whenever my skin feels extra oily.

I’ve got sensitive skin and have to be careful not to dry it out but also keep pores clean. I’ve tried all sorts of products to moisturize and keep pimples away. Skip all those complicated routines. I use this to gently scrub my t zone after a mild cleanser and follow with a moisturizer. I use with Cera Ve cleansers/moisturizes and my skin has never been better. If I do get a hormonal break out, dabbing this in the problem area a few times throughout the day helps to clear it up. This natural toner is a good value for the money. I like that it’s pure and fragrance free. I also tried the moisturizing scented one and I didn’t like it. It wasn’t as high in witch hazel purity and it stunk like cheap perfume. This one is the best. So glad I found it.

extraits.titre: Helps reduce pores for us large pored ladies!
extraits.texte: This is a new staple in the skin care routine. I've always had large pores and this toner helps minimize them. It leaves my skin with a really nice texture and I feel like it's reduced my redness as well! 10/10!!
I love that this removes dark spots and gets rid of oily skin.

This was my 2nd purchase from Amazon of this product. And all I can say is its worth it. I have a very oily acne-prone skin and I suffer from eczema. So I always opt to use gentle and bio products The scent may put you off but its something you can disregard as compared to the outcome. It will not make your skin too dry but it helps heal break out fast. It just works for me.
